Pakistan Faces LNG Shortage Amid Hormuz Strait Tensions

Pakistan is facing a severe liquefied natural gas (LNG) shortage due to tensions in the Hormuz Strait, which supplies the country's main energy source. The shortage has raised concerns about the impact on Pakistan's economy and energy security. The situation has been exacerbated by recent flare-ups in the region, including a recent incident involving Iran and Saudi Arabia. Pakistan is now urgently seeking alternative sources of LNG to mitigate the crisis.
